=== Day 2: the town meeting ===
Merrin: "I cannot carry this omen alone another hour: From my window, I saw Odette out in the street last night."  [case board: #51]
Agnes: "I'll not keep secrets from my neighbors when we're in such need. I am the Medium."  [case board: #52]
Nisha: "To eliminate an unnecessary unknown from the town's reasoning: I am the Warden."  [case board: #53]
Bartholomew: "Don't trust Lian. My own reading says the people living on the Docks aren't all on one side, and they live there."  [case board: #54]
Lian: "I don't have hard proof on Odette yet, still—something doesn't add up there."  [case board: #55]
Odette: "Miraculously, Bartholomew and I are of one mind regarding Lian."  [case board: #56]
Lian: "Here's what the town needs to know to narrow the list: I am the Psychologist."
Lian: "Last night, none of the information I heard on day 1 was a lie or misread."  [case board: #57, #58]
Constance: "In the interest of the town and proper order, I shall be plain: I am the Clerk."
Constance: "The night before you arrived, I learned that one of Odette and Hollis is the Martyr."
Constance: "I concur with Lian regarding Odette. I hold a further ground which prudence bids me retain for now."  [case board: #59, #60, #61]
Hollis: "I concur with Lian's assessment of Odette. An additional private ground remains undisclosed for the present."  [case board: #62]
Fenwick: "Before the curtain rises, a word: This afternoon, on the Square I sensed 0 evil among Odette, Merrin, Agnes, Greta."  [case board: #63]
Agnes: "I hate to point a finger, neighbors, yet something doesn't sit right with me about Nisha."  [case board: #64]
Nisha: "My own reckoning agrees with Bartholomew about Lian. I guarded Fenwick that night, and their account of that night doesn't fit it."  [case board: #30]
Greta: "Bartholomew is right on the money about Lian."
Greta: "From my window, I saw Constance out in the street last night."  [case board: #65, #66]
Merrin: "Let the heavens bear witness before the fiend strikes me down in my bed—I am the Rumormonger!"
Merrin: "The night before you arrived, I heard that one of Lian and Nisha is Marked, and may read as evil."
Merrin: "A dark portent warns me against Hollis, though I daren't speak its name before the hall yet!"  [case board: #67, #68, #69]
Hollis: "So that the record is free of ambiguity on this point: I am the Martyr."
Hollis: "Last night, I have given my life over for Bartholomew, should the town ever hang them."  [case board: #70, #71]

=== Day 3: the town meeting ===
Merrin: "Oh, a chill runs down my spine whenever Lian passes—mark them well, neighbors!"  [case board: #95]
Lian: "Before we waste time: Last night, I learned that at least one of these two statements from day 2 was a lie or misreading: Merrin's Rumormonger reading (the night before you arrived); or Fenwick's Dowser reading (night 2)."
Lian: "Odette belongs at the top of our list. I saw them out in the street from my window last night."  [case board: #96, #68, #63, #97, #55]
Agnes: "I hate to point a finger, neighbors, yet something doesn't sit right with me about Bartholomew."  [case board: #98]
Nisha: "Constance raises a serious flag on the board. I guarded Fenwick that night, and their account of that night doesn't fit it."  [case board: #99]
Odette: "Since we are doing public confessions today, let's get mine over with: I am the Night Watch."
Odette: "The night before you arrived, I watched the Docks: nobody stirred."
Odette: "On the first night, I watched the Market: nobody stirred."
Odette: "Last night, I watched Chapel Hill: I saw Constance pass by."
Odette: "Miraculously, Nisha and I are of one mind regarding Constance."  [case board: #100, #101, #102, #103, #104]
Fenwick: "Ah, I have a tidbit for your ledger: This afternoon, on the Docks I sensed 2 evil among Nisha, Hollis, Odette."  [case board: #105]
Hollis: "I concur with Lian's assessment of Odette."  [case board: #106]
